name: Valkyrie
identity_check: Beth Turner's solo-GP early-stage fund Valkyrie (also written Valkyrie Ventures; ex-SV Angel), which Forbes Argentina and Ecosistema Startup describe as a US$45M fund launched in 2025 and Pulse 2.0 lists as an investor in Cascade Space. valkyrie.vc (Valkyrie Ventures, contact address valkyrieventures@gmail.com) was fetched but never names Turner, so the link between that domain and the fund rests on the shared name only. Ruled out from search results: Valkyrie Investments (crypto asset manager that launched a VC arm, Blockworks/CoinDesk/The Block), Valkyrie Intelligence / Andromeda (Austin AI company), Valkyrie Fund (Mountain View, separate profiles), and the Kratos Valkyrie drone.
